name: DISA
description: AI/ML-assisted memory modeling for stripped binaries — recovering code layout and memory boundaries to power value-set analysis for more accurate indirect call resolution.

name: iResolveX (under review, NDSS)
description: Introduces a new meta-CFG construct — p-IndirectCFG — so downstream analyses get a CFG customized to their own precision/recall needs, instead of one traditional one-size-fits-all CFG.

name: CAIR (targeting ASIACCS 2027)
description: Separates weak from strong program-analysis evidence, using ML to combine them for more precise indirect call resolution.

name: Agentic Fuzzing for Indirect-Call Ground Truth
description: An AFL++-based agentic fuzzer built to establish complete ground truth for indirect-call pairs via a residual-risk framing.

name: ACaM — Agent Capability Model (IBM Research)
description: A neurosymbolic solution for agentic vulnerability discovery — pairing program analysis with LLM semantic-lifting to detect threats across LLM agent pipelines (LangChain/LangGraph, extending to CrewAI/AutoGen): prompt injection, exfiltration chains, and policy violations.
